text:
mira: quick ping — we have a late demo tomorrow 10:00 UTC for Acme. EU-west H100 pool is at 24/25 and we need one extra rack for predictable latency. Can we get a short-term quota bump or swap one rack from APAC? tagging @kevin @vendor-sally. I referenced the infra PR that adds a demo pool (PR #7823).

vendor-sally: we can spare one H100 rack from apac3 and do a host-level swap, can have it reserved and shipped as a logical swap by EOD tomorrow. Need confirmation on target IP ranges and funding code. ETA to reserve: ~16:00 PT. Shipping manifest will follow.

kevin: cost-wise this fits the demo budget but finance needs a PO first. Mira, can you open a quick ticket with cost code? I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: quota-check: scanned project redwood-prod.
```
project: redwood-prod
region: europe-west1
current_h100_instances: 24
quota_limit: 25
pending_requests: 0
```

lia: also flag for routing: when the new pool lands we should mark it demo-priority=true so the console routing policy pins the canary traffic. Otherwise real user traffic might get mixed in.

esteban: terraform snippet to create the transient pool (copy from PR):
```
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "eu_demo" {
  name = "eu-demo-acme"
  size = 1
  sku  = "h100"
  labels = { demo = "true" }
}
```
Also note the PR touches the autoscaler config (check line 56-72). Link to PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pull/7823

mira: thanks — I'll open the finance ticket now (FIN-2026-19) and ping procurement. If vendor-sally confirms reserve I'll merge PR and kick a smoke test.

vendor-sally: confirmed reservation done, shipping ref S-90012, manifest will be uploaded to the vendor portal by 15:30 PT. Need confirmation of target CIDR: use 10.40.0.0/22 for the pool.

kevin: timeline check — Mira, is the PR merge-ready? If so I'll start the PO process.

mira: PR is green except a flaky runtime test; small follow-up in PR #7830 fixes it. I'll merge in ~30m after CI re-run. Will post here once merged and when the ticket is created.

deploy-bot: canary schedule created: start=2026-05-12T09:15:00Z target=eu-west1, pools=[eu-demo-acme], watch=10m

mira: filing FIN ticket now and adding cost breakdown + vendor manifest link. Will tag infra-oncall if anything goes sideways. Thanks all!
